results.question: What checked exception does Hex.decodeHex(char[], byte[], int) throw for an odd number of input digits?

citations.excerpt: public static int decodeHex(char[] data, byte[] out, int outOffset) throws DecoderException

Converts an array of characters representing hexadecimal values into an array of bytes of those same values. The returned array will be half the length of the passed array, as it takes two characters to represent any given byte. An exception is thrown if the passed char array has an odd number of elements.

results.question: When does URLCodec.decodeUrl(BitSet, byte[]) turn a plus into a space instead of preserving the plus?
results.answer: It turns a plus into a space only when the plus is not marked safe and space is marked safe. If plus is marked safe, it preserves it.

citations.excerpt: A percent sign marked safe is copied literally; otherwise it starts a two-digit hexadecimal escape. A plus sign marked safe is copied literally. Otherwise, a plus sign becomes a space only if space is marked safe. All other bytes are copied unchanged. A `null` bitset selects the default `www-form-urlencoded` safe set, giving the same behavior as [`decodeUrl(byte[])`](URLCodec.md#decodeUrl%28byte[]%29) [L391].

[E44] #decodeUrl(java.util.BitSet,byte[])
[E45] ```java
[E46] public static final byte[] decodeUrl(BitSet urlsafe, byte[] bytes) throws DecoderException
[E47] ```
[E48] Since 1.23.0.
[E49] Decodes an array of bytes using the safe set supplied to [`encodeUrl(BitSet, byte[])`](URLCodec.md#encodeUrl%28java.util.BitSet,byte[]%29) [L390].
[E50] A percent sign marked safe is copied literally; otherwise it starts a two-digit hexadecimal escape. A plus sign marked safe is copied literally. Otherwise, a plus sign becomes a space only if space is marked safe. All other bytes are copied unchanged. A `null` bitset selects the default `www-form-urlencoded` safe set, giving the same behavior as [`decodeUrl(byte[])`](URLCodec.md#decodeUrl%28byte[]%29) [L391].
[E51] Not every safe set permits a round trip. If both space and plus are marked safe, the encoder maps both to plus and this method preserves that plus. If percent is marked safe, literal percent signs cannot be distinguished from generated escapes, so this method preserves all percent signs, including generated escapes. Use a safe set that excludes percent and does not mark both space and plus safe when a round trip is required.
[E52] **Parameters**
[E53] - `urlsafe` `BitSet`: bitset of characters deemed URL safe during encoding, or `null` to use the default safe set.
[E54] - `bytes` `byte[]`: array of encoded bytes, or `null`.
[E55] **→ Returns** `byte[]`: array of decoded bytes, or `null` if the input is `null`.
[E56] **↯ Throws**
[E57] - [`DecoderException`](../DecoderException.md) [L382]: if percent is not marked safe and an escape is incomplete or contains invalid hexadecimal digits.
[E58] ### decodeUrl(byte\[\])

[E60] ```java
